## Purpose

Provide mutation and copy-number status for the Shorthouse cell lines from
DepMap 24Q4, the source chosen in Audit 4 (decision D10). This step records
the status and DepMap's annotation flags; which flag defines "mutated" for a
gene is decided later, when contrasts are chosen.

## Inputs

- `data/derived/cancer-cell-lines/shorthouse_v1/02_cell_lines.tsv` (accessions)
- DepMap 24Q4 Public (`data/raw/cancer-cell-lines/depmap_24Q4/`, local only; see `data/raw/cancer-cell-lines/README.md`):
  `Model.csv`, `OmicsSomaticMutations.csv`, `OmicsAbsoluteCNGene.csv`

## Methods

Mutation and copy-number status were taken from DepMap 24Q4 Public (Broad
Institute; Figshare doi:10.25452/figshare.plus.27993248.v1). Cell lines were
matched to DepMap models by their Cellosaurus accession (RRID). For every line
and gene, all protein-changing somatic variants (Mutect2 calls) were recorded
with DepMap's annotation: hotspot (Hess et al. 2019, OncoKB, COSMIC tier 1),
likely loss of function, Hess driver, and high impact in an oncogene or tumour
suppressor. Gene-level absolute copy number (PureCN) was recorded, and a gene
was called homozygously deleted at copy number 0. The engineered line
NCIH460DNP53 shares the parental accession and receives no status.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

source(here::here("analyses/cancer-cell-lines/R/use_case.R"))
source(here::here("analyses/cancer-cell-lines/R/plotting.R"))
config <- load_config()
raw_dir <- uc_dir(config, "raw")
derived_dir <- uc_dir(config, "derived")
output_dir <- uc_dir(config, "output", "04_depmap_status")

# DepMap files of the release given in config.yml
depmap_dir <- file.path(raw_dir, config$depmap$dir)
depmap_files <- c(
    models = file.path(depmap_dir, "Model.csv"),
    mutations = file.path(depmap_dir, "OmicsSomaticMutations.csv"),
    copy_number = file.path(depmap_dir, "OmicsAbsoluteCNGene.csv")
)
stopifnot(all(file.exists(depmap_files)))

cell_lines <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(derived_dir, "02_cell_lines.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Match cell lines to DepMap models

```{r match}
# DepMap models with their RRID (= Cellosaurus accession)
models <- readr::read_csv(depmap_files[["models"]], show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    select(ModelID, RRID, depmap_name = CellLineName, OncotreeLineage)

# the engineered derivative gets no status (it would inherit the parental model)
matched <- cell_lines %>%
    select(line, accession, engineered) %>%
    left_join(models, by = c("accession" = "RRID")) %>%
    mutate(ModelID = if_else(engineered, NA_character_, ModelID))

# check: never more than one model per line
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(matched$line))
c(lines = nrow(matched), matched = sum(!is.na(matched$ModelID)))

matched %>%
    filter(is.na(ModelID)) %>%
    select(line, accession, engineered) %>%
    preview_table(caption = "Lines without DepMap model")
model_of_line <- filter(matched, !is.na(ModelID)) %>% select(line, ModelID)
```

## Mutations

```{r mutations}
# protein-changing somatic variants of the matched models, with DepMap's flags
flag_columns <- c("Hotspot", "LikelyLoF", "HessDriver", "OncogeneHighImpact", "TumorSuppressorHighImpact")
variants <- data.table::fread(
    depmap_files[["mutations"]],
    select = c("ModelID", "HugoSymbol", "ProteinChange", "VariantInfo", flag_columns)
) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    inner_join(model_of_line, by = "ModelID")

# one row per line and gene: number of variants, protein changes and whether
# any variant carries each flag
mutation_status <- variants %>%
    group_by(line, gene = HugoSymbol) %>%
    summarise(
        n_variants = n(),
        protein_changes = paste(unique(na.omit(ProteinChange)), collapse = "; "),
        hotspot = any(Hotspot),
        likely_lof = any(LikelyLoF),
        hess_driver = any(HessDriver),
        oncogene_high_impact = any(OncogeneHighImpact),
        tumor_suppressor_high_impact = any(TumorSuppressorHighImpact),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(likely_driver = hotspot | likely_lof | hess_driver | oncogene_high_impact | tumor_suppressor_high_impact)

c(lines = n_distinct(mutation_status$line), line_gene_pairs = nrow(mutation_status),
  likely_driver_pairs = sum(mutation_status$likely_driver))
preview_table(mutation_status, caption = "Mutation status per line and gene")

# mutated genes per line under both definitions
per_line <- mutation_status %>%
    group_by(line) %>%
    summarise(any = n(), likely_driver = sum(likely_driver), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_longer(-line, names_to = "definition", values_to = "genes")
p <- ggplot(per_line, aes(genes, fill = definition)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50, position = "identity", alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(any = "#0072B2", likely_driver = "#D55E00"),
                      labels = c(any = "any protein-changing", likely_driver = "likely driver")) +
    labs(x = "Mutated genes per line (log scale)", y = "Lines", fill = NULL,
         title = "Mutated genes per line in DepMap 24Q4") +
    theme_uc()
save_figure(p, "genes_per_line", output_dir)
p
```

## Copy number

```{r copy-number}
# gene-level absolute copy number: models (rows) × genes ("SYMBOL (Entrez)")
cn <- data.table::fread(depmap_files[["copy_number"]])
cn <- as.data.frame(cn)
rownames(cn) <- cn[[1]]
cn <- as.matrix(cn[, -1])
colnames(cn) <- sub(" \\(.*$", "", colnames(cn))

# rows for the matched lines that have copy number
cn_lines <- model_of_line %>% filter(ModelID %in% rownames(cn))
copy_number <- cn[cn_lines$ModelID, , drop = FALSE]
rownames(copy_number) <- cn_lines$line
c(lines_with_mutation_calls = n_distinct(model_of_line$line), lines_with_copy_number = nrow(copy_number),
  genes = ncol(copy_number))

# homozygous deletions: absolute copy number 0
deletions <- which(copy_number == 0, arr.ind = TRUE)
homozygous_deletions <- tibble(line = rownames(copy_number)[deletions[, 1]],
                               gene = colnames(copy_number)[deletions[, 2]])
homozygous_deletions %>% count(gene, sort = TRUE) %>%
    preview_table(caption = "Genes with homozygous deletion, number of lines")
```

## Outputs

```{r save}
out <- c(
    model_matches = file.path(derived_dir, "04_depmap_models.tsv"),
    mutation_status = file.path(derived_dir, "04_mutation_status.tsv"),
    copy_number = file.path(derived_dir, "04_copy_number.rds"),
    deletions = file.path(derived_dir, "04_homozygous_deletions.tsv")
)
readr::write_tsv(matched, out[["model_matches"]])
readr::write_tsv(mutation_status, out[["mutation_status"]])
saveRDS(copy_number, out[["copy_number"]])
readr::write_tsv(homozygous_deletions, out[["deletions"]])
write_manifest(out, c(cell_lines = file.path(derived_dir, "02_cell_lines.tsv"), depmap_files),
               file.path(derived_dir, "04_manifest.json"),
               extra = list(depmap_release = config$depmap$release, depmap_doi = config$depmap$doi))
```

## Interpretation

Most Shorthouse lines have DepMap mutation calls; fewer have copy number,
because DepMap omits copy number for some high-ploidy samples. Lines without
DepMap data are flagged in the analysis data set and left out of mutation
models (decision D16).
